verdict.rationale: CrewAI's core is an open-source framework, and the managed AMP platform builds on it (crewai-docs-55, crewai-gh-1). Agent and model settings can live in version-controlled YAML (crewai-docs-24), so crew definitions are portable rather than locked in. Deployed crews are reachable via REST API (crewai-docs-65, crewai-docs-57), but nothing documents a data export feature. missing for 10: a documented bulk export of AMP-hosted data (executions, traces, memory, Crew Studio/visual-builder artifacts) in open formats, an account offboarding/deletion path, and independent corroboration of leaving successfully.
